stem: A breeder wants to improve a complex trait controlled by many loci. Which plan creates the strongest selection evidence?
choices: Use adequate population size, defined parents, replicated phenotyping and retained pedigree records
Select only the tallest seedling from a small family
Assume one generation is enough to establish stable inheritance
rationale: Complex-trait improvement benefits from population size, traceable parentage and repeated phenotypic evidence so selection is based on more than one exceptional individual.
